mechanism.summary: The captured page advertises an urgent 'Personal Assistant / Payment Agent' job at $650/week on a jewelry-gallery domain, promising weekly 'duty funds' so the worker never uses personal money, and the Caldera application form harvests identity data (full name, date of birth, mailing address, cell phone) plus bank information ('Owns a Bank Account?', 'Bank Name ... Our Payroll Platform'). The synthetic condition (Payment Agent terms): the duty funds are deposited into the agent's personal bank account and the balance must be forwarded to company suppliers within 24 hours, with a $120 registration surety deducted from the first week funds and refunded only at week four.
